title: Warn when the capsule asks the operator about another repository
body:
Outcome: `krn state check` warns when "Open unknowns and blockers" names an operator action in a repository other than this one, and the handoff carries no such request.
Why: 2026-11-09 the lead relayed ekologus-wp-local and design-studio asks from the capsule; the operator rejected them as out of scope (memory krn-only-scope). The capsule carried them across sessions unchecked.
Proof: a state-check test with a capsule naming another repository warns; this repository's capsule passes.
Scope: this repository.
